summary: Shared knowledge space vNext — one user space for all nodes; provenance-rich versioned records; no per-node knowledge silos
implementation: electron/tenx/knowledge-space.ts: TenxKnowledgeSpace durable store (schemaVersion 1) over the 10A KnowledgeRecordVNext contract; contribute (first version) / supersede (previous ACTIVE → SUPERSEDED, new version appended — never a silent overwrite) / get (latest ACTIVE) / history (full version chain) / list (scope filter, global/project/task/user) / durable restore; records carry knowledgeId/content/source/artifactRef/createdByNode/createdAt/updatedAt/confidence/scope/validity/version/provenance/state
One space serves all nodes — node-local fallback (10J) is a later cache layer, not a second personality knowledge base.
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10g.test.ts (5 tests): two nodes contribute into ONE user space; full provenance fields stored; supersede keeps SUPERSEDED v1 + ACTIVE v2 in history (no silent overwrite); scope filtering; durable restart restores records + history
notes: 10H pipeline / 10I dedup-conflict / 10J fallback-sync build on this store in later phases.
